description: Extract clean content from a webpage. Returns Markdown, plain text, metadata, links, JSON-LD schema, and content sections. Use this for scraping, RAG ingestion, or content analysis.

include.description: Which fields to include in the response.

mode.description: 'structured' for parsed data, 'raw' for HTML, 'both' for everything.

render.description: Rendering mode. 'never' = fast static fetch (1 credit). 'auto' = static first, browser if needed. 'always' = browser rendering (5 credits).

wait_for_selector.description: CSS selector to wait for on rendered pages.

wait_until.description: Browser navigation milestone. Only used with browser rendering.

name: tooltrace_extract
